privacy_data.meaningZh: 学生使用AI须经教师批准；Gemini及NotebookLM的数据说明针对NYU机构账号，不适用于所有AI服务。

approved_tools.en: NYU supports institutional Gemini and NotebookLM; other services have tool-specific conditions. NYU does not license or endorse AI detectors.
approved_tools.zh: NYU支持机构账号的Gemini及NotebookLM，其他服务各有条件；NYU不采购或背书AI检测工具。

research_publication.en: The current reviewed Claims do not specify a publication AI-use rule. Check the relevant journal or research-unit instructions.
